prompt: curl upload-file stdin non-blocking mode filename
answer:
Use a single period (`.`) as the upload filename:

```bash
curl -T. https://example.com/upload
```

`-T-` reads from stdin in normal blocking mode, while `-T.` reads from stdin in non-blocking mode, allowing curl to read server output while uploading.
